set -euo pipefail

from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee'), Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee')]
root=next((r for r in roots if r.exists()), None)
if root is None: raise SystemExit('ezbee headers missing')
needles=['ias_zone_action','IAS_ZONE','status_change_notif','ZONE_STATUS_CHANGE','enroll','CIE_ADDRESS','cluster_action_handler','action_handler_register']
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.h')):
    ls=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    hits=[i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if any(n.lower() in l.lower() for n in needles)]
    if not hits: continue
    if 'ias_zone' not in str(p).lower() and not any('cluster_action' in ls[i].lower() for i in hits): continue
    print('===',p,'===')
    shown=[]
    for i in hits:
        lo=max(0,i-6); hi=min(len(ls),i+18)
        if any(lo>=a and hi<=b for a,b in shown): continue
        shown.append((lo,hi))
        print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{ls[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
